personal-training.title: A private service around your plans
personal-training.body: Private Strength Training starts with what you want from the visit and the setting you already have. You may be staying in a Bali villa, living in a Jakarta apartment or planning for a private household. The aim is to build general strength, return to exercise or keep a routine during a stay. The format matters more than a generic category name: participant numbers, the length of the visit, equipment and professional scope all shape the right request. PersonalFitness brings those practical details into one conversation so you can decide with a clear understanding of the service. Availability is confirmed for your actual dates and area.

personal-training.title: What the visit can involve

Before the main activity, the professional should review the practical brief, check the available setting and explain what will happen. You can ask about pace, privacy, comfort and anything that changes the agreed format. A useful visit has a clear beginning, a realistic main activity and time to finish without rushing. Where several formats appear below, choose the one closest to your goal; they are alternatives rather than activities automatically included in every booking.

personal-training.title: Making your space work
personal-training.body: The usual starting point is a clear living-room floor, shaded terrace or suitable private gym. A photograph of the proposed area can sometimes help with planning, but access and safety still need the appropriate professional's judgement. Tell the coordinator about stairs, parking, security desks, power, water, noise restrictions and any host or building permission that affects arrival. Special equipment should be named in the quote rather than assumed to exist. If a home setup is unsuitable, the team should discuss an appropriate alternative before taking payment. Travelling to another venue, hiring a room or bringing unusual equipment can change the total.

Start with the most relevant format rather than booking the longest visit by default. Let the coordinator know whether the participants have compatible goals and experience. personal-training.title: Compare the scope before choosing a format
personal-training.body: Private Strength Training: Individual exercise coaching around goals and available equipment. General fitness only; ordinary portable kit. Beginner strength training: Learn basic exercise technique and build a repeatable routine. Adapt load and pace to experience. Strength and muscle training: Progressive resistance training with an agreed equipment plan. Confirm adequate resistance equipment before quoting. Weight management fitness: Exercise coaching and activity habits that support weight goals. No promised weight loss or clinical diet prescription. Low impact private strength training: A lower impact workout matched to current fitness. Pain or medical concerns go to an appropriate professional. Functional fitness: Practice useful strength, movement control and general fitness work. Confirm safe floor space and equipment. HIIT intervals: A coached interval workout adapted to experience and readiness. Not a default recommendation for every customer. Bodyweight and calisthenics: Build strength using bodyweight progressions and simple equipment. Check any bars or anchor points before use. Kettlebell coaching: Learn kettlebell technique and a progressive strength routine. Agree bell weights, transport and floor protection. Couples private strength training: A shared workout with suitable individual exercise adjustments. Two compatible adults; no automatic addition beyond two. Exercise assessment and written plan: Review fitness goals and leave with an exercise plan. Non-diagnostic coaching assessment; specify written deliverable. When comparing these options, check the appointment length, number of participants and delivery setting together. A longer format can include a different sequence or preparation requirement rather than simply more of the same activity. Ask for the exact deliverable and any optional additions in the written quote. If the listed format does not match your household, request an individual proposal instead of assuming that an extra guest, different venue or additional task can be added at the same price.

personal-training.title: Where this fits in a personal wellness schedule
personal-training.body: You can request private strength training as a single visit or include it in a wider wellness schedule. For example, a household may keep a regular yoga morning and choose another service later in the week, with different family members attending different visits. Your coordinator checks whether the timing, staffing and setting work together. Start with one paid session if you want to understand the approach first. A monthly plan is a four-week block paid ahead after the exact diary is agreed. Only eligible fitness visits earn the published programme savings; food, equipment, massage and specialist work are priced on their own terms.

personal-training.title: Feedback, preferences and continuity
personal-training.body: For a managed programme, agree the practical preferences you want your coordinator to remember. With your permission, relevant non-clinical notes can be passed to the next assigned professional. Each provider still checks the current brief rather than relying on an old note. bodywork-recovery.title: What happens in the hour
bodywork-recovery.body: Bodywork and recovery is a wellness hour. It can include assisted stretching, myofascial release and a slower finish so the guest can relax. The instructor works at a pressure the guest can talk through. The aim is to feel looser and calmer after travel, a long walk, or a training day. It is guided movement and relaxation. It is not a promise that a joint, a muscle or a night of sleep will change in a particular way.

bodywork-recovery.title: Assisted stretching
bodywork-recovery.body: Assisted stretching means the instructor helps the guest hold an easy position a little longer than they would alone. Typical positions use a mat: a gentle hip opener, a hamstring fold with a strap if one is to hand, and an upper-back reach. The guest stays in charge of the range. If a position is too much, it is changed. Clothing stays comfortable. No oil is required unless the quote says a light finish is included.

bodywork-recovery.title: Myofascial release, in plain words
bodywork-recovery.body: Myofascial release here means slow, broad pressure with hands or a simple ball on muscles that feel tight from sitting or training. It is a wellness technique used inside a fitness hour. The instructor avoids forcing a joint and avoids any claim that the pressure fixes a medical problem. Guests who want a quiet hour after a flight often choose this over a high-energy session. Say so in the first message so the instructor brings the right small tools.

bodywork-recovery.title: How it differs from mobility coaching
bodywork-recovery.body: Mobility coaching is a more active hour of movement you repeat on your own. Bodywork and recovery is slower, with more hands-on stretching and time lying down. Both are wellness. Choose mobility when the guest wants to learn a routine. Choose bodywork when the guest wants to be guided through stretches and then rest. A stay can use both on different days. They are booked as separate sessions with their own quotes.

bodywork-recovery.title: How a villa hour is arranged
bodywork-recovery.body: A Bodywork and recovery session is arranged for the villa or home the guest is already using. The villa manager or the guest sends the area, a two-hour window, and whether one or two people will join. A coordinator checks that a vetted instructor can reach the address and writes the total before anyone pays. The page rate is a starting point. The quote is the agreement.

bodywork-recovery.title: What you are paying for
bodywork-recovery.body: The anchor rate is Rp 1.050.000 for 60 minutes and one guest. A 3-session pack is Rp 950.000 a session, Rp 2.850.000 in total, which saves Rp 300.000. A 5-session pack is Rp 900.000 a session, Rp 4.500.000 in total, which saves Rp 750.000. A 10-session pack is Rp 800.000 a session, Rp 8.000.000 in total, which saves Rp 2.500.000. Those savings are measured against Rp 1.050.000 per session. A second guest adds Rp 250.000 to each session when the published rate is for one person. Ninety minutes adds 45 percent of the session rate. The pack saving is shown on the estimator before you send the request.

bodywork-recovery.title: Travel and timing
bodywork-recovery.body: Standard travel is included in central areas such as Canggu, Seminyak, South Jakarta and Central Jakarta. Outer areas, such as Uluwatu, incur a flat travel fee of Rp 50.000 to Rp 100.000 max, confirmed in your written quote. North, West and East Jakarta are by request. Nothing on this page promises an arrival at a fixed minute. The session is subject to instructor availability and location confirmation.

bodywork-recovery.title: The room
bodywork-recovery.body: Use a clear indoor floor or a shaded terrace with room to move an arm’s length from furniture. Tell the coordinator about stairs, a locked gate, a security desk, or a house rule about music and shoes. A photograph can help, but the quote still names the entrance. If the space is too tight, the coordinator says so before payment. Parking and building fees, when they exist, are written as extras rather than assumed.

bodywork-recovery.title: Who the hour suits
bodywork-recovery.body: The hour suits adult guests who want a private session during a stay, and residents who want the same instructor to return. It suits a villa manager who wants a simple menu for guests: the guest pays the published rate, the session happens at the villa, and the manager does not have to staff it. One guest is the usual booking. Two guests can share the hour when the second person is on the quote.

bodywork-recovery.title: How to request it
bodywork-recovery.body: Send WhatsApp +62 811-3803-488 or email hello@personalfitness.id with the session name, Bali or Jakarta, the area, a window, and the guest count. Add whether the host or the guest is paying. Keep card numbers and identity documents out of the chat. Free rescheduling is available up to 36 hours before the session. Inside 36 hours the session is charged, because the instructor’s time was held. If the instructor cannot attend, the session is not charged.

bodywork-recovery.title: What the written quote names
bodywork-recovery.body: The quote names the service, the date window, the duration, the guest count, the session rate, any second-guest amount, any outer-area travel fee, and the person who will arrive. It also names how to pay and the 36-hour rescheduling line. A message in chat is a request. The booking exists when the quote is accepted and payment is confirmed using the details in the written quote.

bodywork-recovery.title: Packs for a short or long stay
bodywork-recovery.body: A weekend often needs a single session. A short stay of several days can use the 3-session pack. A week with a session most mornings often fits the 5-session pack, which is the one most guests choose. A longer stay or a resident who wants a standing rhythm can use the 10-session pack. Unused sessions follow the validity window written on the quote. The pack is not an open membership and it does not renew by itself.

bodywork-recovery.body: Guests can mix this hour with private yoga, mat Pilates, mobility coaching, boxing fitness, guided meditation or private strength training on other days. Each format keeps its own rate unless the quote applies a pack. The estimator on the pricing page shows the starting total for one discipline at a time. A mixed week is priced on the programmes page and then confirmed in writing. The same travel note applies to every visit.

bodywork-recovery.title: A practical first message
bodywork-recovery.body: Five lines are enough. Name the session. Name the area. Give a window such as Tuesday 07:00 to 09:00. Say one guest or two. Say whether a mat is already in the villa. The coordinator replies with availability and a total. You can change the window up to 36 hours before the session without a fee. Sessions are delivered by vetted instructors, and the person who comes is named before you pay.

zumba-dance-fitness.title: What happens in the hour
zumba-dance-fitness.body: Zumba and dance fitness is a high-energy, fun cardio hour at the villa. The instructor teaches short, repeatable steps to music and keeps the pace where the guest can smile and still talk. It is a workout, not a performance. No partner choreography is required. The guest can keep the steps small if the floor is compact. The hour ends with an easier track so nobody stops suddenly.

zumba-dance-fitness.title: Music and neighbours
zumba-dance-fitness.body: Music is part of the session, so the first message should mention quiet hours, open villas, or a preference for a speaker versus the instructor’s phone. The volume stays inside what the house allows. If a neighbour rule is strict, the instructor uses a lower volume and bigger steps rather than cancelling the energy of the hour. Shoes or bare feet are agreed before the day, based on the floor.

zumba-dance-fitness.title: Who enjoys it
zumba-dance-fitness.body: The hour suits guests who want to move and laugh rather than count repetitions. It suits a couple when both people want the same playlist. It is less suitable as a first session for someone who wants slow strength practice; that guest should book private strength training instead. Beginners are welcome. The steps are shown, then repeated. Nobody is asked to perform alone.

zumba-dance-fitness.title: Space and impact
zumba-dance-fitness.body: Dance fitness needs a little more width than a mat class: room for a step to the side and a turn. A living room with the coffee table moved is the usual setting. A wet deck is a poor idea. Tell the coordinator if the floor is tile, wood or stone so the instructor can choose lower-impact steps. Jumping is optional. The quote can say “low impact” if knees prefer a softer hour.
